## Independent bounded reassessment

The reviewer authored no engineering or source/plan/model content. This same original M4 reporter freshly inspected the original Proposal assessor's r6, its exact current subjects and the unchanged engineering diff. All source-transfer/consumer/retention conclusions of M4 r1 retain applicability because no engineering changed after a0a59c66. This approval is a new current judgment, not a rewrite of r1. No activity, work or engineering was changed.

Resolved by original M4 reporter after reading approved/current proposal-review-r6. The original independent Proposal assessor explicitly ends current reliance on all six removed originals, names the current living-owner basis, and preserves r5 original subjects/judgment with stale applicability. R6 corrects its own earlier dependence; no other assessor substitutes that disposition. M4 engineering is unchanged. The earlier release-m4-implementation-r1 statement overstated what r5 had done; it remains a historical overstatement corrected now by r6 and this review, not a retroactive claim that r5 already sufficed.

R6 approves only unchanged direction; technical/source-transfer completeness remains with Design and M4, and final adoption remains conditional on final independent whole-change review and successful Verify. Its eight current subjects name the proposal, Constitution/Vision, living Release/System/Design, retained R7/R8 owner and follow-up register. None requires one of the six removed originals. Design r5 and Delivery r2 continue on their explicit current-map basis; no proposal, requirement, plan or source-disposition change was introduced by r6.

## Preserved whole-M4 engineering assessment

Exactly four spec/test-spec documents and two ADRs were removed under the approved map and retention policy, without an archive/redirect or seventh deletion. The mixed architecture retains exact public npm flow, three adapter/history paragraphs and all Mermaid blocks; only mapped standing paragraphs and current obsolete navigation were removed. Release retains precise applicable obligations, operational representations, decisions and supersessions. FU013 keeps Distribution/Installation open and conditions Release adoption on Verify.

The literal-audit baseline remains SHA2569859cd5ef43ff2cb1216a03e53b2ef5d45919cca3bf5868dc6d81d87682b43a1; historical activation inventory remains09a4f682976282dcaa131818f495717909230098dea59f8efb3ffa1790d73cde. Current reader searches distinguish live historical-path resources from removed prose. Scripts, packages, skills, schemas, templates, workflow/configuration and archive inputs are unchanged from reviewed M3, so its integrated proof remains applicable with M4's deletion-aware reader/semantic checks. This statement is not the final whole-change judgment.

## Checks and limits

Independent checks retained from r1: exact six-file deletion assertion; base/current byte checks of baseline, activation inventory, retained npm/adapter text and diagrams; scoped operational-diff absence; actual current reader search; source-map and current-basis assessment. Fresh checks: full r6 review read, refreshed exact subjects and `git diff --name-only a0a59c66` over engineering/model/architecture/follow-up paths returned empty. The original r1 proof remains valid because that basis is unchanged.

Author M4 range `bash scripts/ci.sh --mode pr --base 6b6db7fcf98d78c2e1f15afe0b5b9ca37d3261d8 --head a0a59c660cea5f062dba93090ed350f8eeac2157` passed all8 selected checks,138.07s total including deletion-aware lifecycle81.61s. Model/prose/direct reader checks passed; readability150 advisories remains disclosed. Earlier explicit-path missing-source failure remains failed; existing revision-bound mode demonstrated deletions without changing validator policy. Full-branch final CI is a separate ongoing observation and is not claimed passed here. No real publication or repeated release experiment was needed for this evidence-only correction.

## Handoff

M4 may close under this milestone assessment. Route must next obtain the separate fresh independent final whole-change Code Review of the complete final range and cross-milestone interactions, followed by distinct Verify. This review claims neither final adoption nor branch/PR/hosted/public-release readiness.
